adjudication.rationale: In `Topic#expandable_first_post?` the embeddable-host gate was removed (`SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? &&` dropped) and the method now only checks `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb). In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb`, the standalone example `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` no longer sets `SiteSetting.embed_truncate = true` or stubs `has_topic_embed?`, so it passes simply because `SiteSetting.embed_truncate` defaults to false, not because any embeddable-host condition is exercised. This means the behavioral change (removing the embeddable_hosts gate) is not actually distinguished/verified by the test suite, but it’s a test coverage issue rather than a production defect shown by the diff.
